data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of deep-sea fishing with the romance of a sunset cruise on the same Marbella charter. The Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2028 gives you two hours of fishing off the Costa del Sol, followed by two hours of cruising along the Golden Mile as the sun sinks behind La Concha. Prices start at €749 for 4 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Upgrade to a Mangusta 80 for €4,719/4h and get a free jet ski. All departures from Puerto Banús Marina. Book via WhatsApp and catch your dinner before the sky steals the show.

How the Combo Charter Works

This is a 4-hour private charter split into two distinct experiences. The first two hours are dedicated to fishing – your skipper takes you to known spots off the Marbella coast, where you can try for sea bass, bream, mackerel, or even dentex depending on the season. All rods, reels, bait, and tackle are provided. After you’ve had your fill, the boat turns toward the sunset. The remaining two hours are a leisurely cruise along the coast, past the Golden Mile and the iconic La Concha mountain, with drinks flowing and music playing. The crew will clean and bag any catch you want to keep.

Which Boats Are Available for the Combo

We offer the combo on several yachts from our fleet, all departing from Puerto Banús. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal at €749 for 4 hours. For a larger party, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers more space and a free jet ski at €4,719 for 4 hours. Other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Fairline Targa 12m are also available – pricing on request via WhatsApp.

What’s Included in the Price

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Fishing gear is provided at no extra cost. There are no hidden fees – what you see is what you pay. The only extras you might want are a tip for the crew or a restaurant to cook your catch.

Best Fishing Spots Near Marbella

Your skipper knows the local waters intimately. Common fishing grounds include the waters off Cabopino, the reefs near Cala del Faro, and the deeper channels around Estepona. Depending on the season, you might hook sea bass, bream, mackerel, or even amberjack. The crew will help with baiting and reeling – no experience needed. If you catch something worth keeping, they’ll clean it and bag it for you.

Sunset Cruise Route Along the Coast

After fishing, the boat heads east toward the Golden Mile and the Marbella Marina. You’ll pass the luxury villas of Río Verde and the pine-clad slopes of La Concha. The sunset here is famous – the sky turns shades of orange, pink, and purple as the sun drops behind the Sierra Blanca. The skipper will find the best angle for photos, and you can enjoy a glass of cava as the light fades.

What to Bring and Wear

Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket – the sea breeze can cool down after sunset. Your phone or camera for photos. All drinks and snacks are provided, so no need to bring food. If you plan to take your catch to a restaurant, ask the crew for a recommendation – many places in Puerto Banús will cook it for you.

How to Book Your Combo Charter

Booking is simple – just message us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat choice. We’ll confirm availability and send payment details. For boats not listed with set prices (like the Ferretti 94 or Maiora 26m), we’ll provide a custom quote. Minimum 48 hours’ notice is recommended, especially for popular sunset slots. Explore all our Marbella boat rental options to find the perfect vessel for your combo adventure.
